title: Don't Worry, Look at the Birds
reflectionQuestion: Jesus said you don't have to carry your worries all by yourself. What is a worry you could hand over, so you don't carry it alone?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Comfort & Bedtime). THE anxiety room -- mood=anxious routes a worried child straight here; likely one of the most-played stories. The IMAGES are the teaching (birds don't plant/store yet are fed; lilies dressed better than a king; 'how much more you'). CRITICAL (Adam): AVOID 'God will take care of you' -- kids hear it literally and it breaks on hard days. Instead: 'you don't have to carry your worries all by yourself' + 'God is with you, God sees you, God cares' (the god-with-not-cause doctrine, feedback_kid_god_with_not_cause). Worry framed as something you can HAND OVER, never something you're scolded for. short+full (the full deepens the bird/flower imagery; no long -- it's a teaching, not an arc). 'God'/'Jesus' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_NATASHA (warm strength -- reassuring without over-promising).
